conclusion: Duplicate shed COW pickup work is a real upstream cause of seed commitment delay.
Removing only impossible duplicate pickup work substantially improves Day4 commitment and productive State.
The local improvement does not improve terminal self; mean terminal self worsens by 4230.6 over fresh5.
Therefore faster seed commitment is not sufficient evidence of a stronger economy and this candidate is rejected without rescue.
The main question returns to which composition/timing of commitment produces durable surplus and terminal value, not how to maximize commitment rate.
boundary: No PLANT or crop action was forced.
Only shed COW pickup requests exceeding observed shed COW stock were suppressed.
No post-hoc rescue condition is added.
Terminal self remains the primary adoption authority.
